title: Towel Shelf With Drying Rack 24.7-Inch Solid Brass, 3-Tier Wall Mount | Spanish Gold | Allied Brass
short_title: Towel Shelf With Drying Rack 24.7-Inch, Spanish Gold
description:
Stop stacking towels on a hook or the counter—add dedicated storage and a built-in drying area in one wall-mounted piece in Spanish Gold, which presents a rich, warm golden tone with European-inspired elegance, bringing luxury and sophistication to distinguished bathrooms. This traditional towel shelf with drying rack brings classic bath accessories styling to everyday organization, making it easy to keep folded towels ready while wet towels air out.

Highlights:
- Spanish Gold elevates the room with luxe gold tones
- Choose from 28 designer finishes to match the rest of your bathroom
- Maintain a clean, refined look with concealed screw mounting hardware
- Match your traditional bathroom hardware with multiple designer finish options available
- Get lasting confidence with a Limited Lifetime Warranty

Specs & Installation:
- Material: Brass
- Mounting: Wall mount
- Dimensions (L x W x H): 24.7 in x 8.9 in x 10.4 in
- Projection: 3.5 in
- Product weight: 5.6 lb
- Assembly: Some assembly required
- Included: Towel shelf arms (3), back plate, and all installation hardware
